newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VASTNED OFFICES PROVISIONAL NET PROFIT UP.
newsitem.headline: VASTNED OFFICES PROVISIONAL NET PROFIT UP.

text.p: Property fund Vastned Offices/Industrial on Friday reported a provisional direct result on investment of 31.2 mln guilders over 1996, up from the previous year's 25.5 million guilders.
Per share the direct investment result rose to 4.88 guilders from a year-earlier 4.79 guilders.
VastNed Offices said that its acquisition of a 78 percent stake in Pays-Bas Property Fund from Securum AB of Sweden would likely take effect in mid-March 1997.

It said that it further proposed to make a public bid for the remaining Pays-Bas shares at the same price it would pay Securum for its holding. The bid was expected to be published in March, it added.
VastNed is to publish its final 1996 figures on March 5.
